letter-memory-v1.title: Letter and Word Memory
letter-memory-v1.skill: Remember letters, letter teams and short words

picture-memory-v1.title: Shape and Number Memory
picture-memory-v1.skill: Match shapes, colors, quantities and sums

sound-memory-v1.title: Sound Memory
sound-memory-v1.skill: Match spoken counts and short melodies by ear

seesaw-v1.title: Seesaw Balance
seesaw-v1.skill: Combine weights to make two sides equal

prompts.letters: Turn over two cards. Find the matching letters.
prompts.case: Find the big and small letter that go together.
prompts.teams: Turn over two cards. Find the matching letter teams.
prompts.words: Turn over two cards. Find the same word.
prompts.numbers: Turn over two cards. Find the matching numbers.
prompts.dots: Match each number with its group of dots.
prompts.shapes: Find two cards with the same shape.
prompts.colors: Find two cards with the same color.
prompts.sums: Match each sum with its number.
prompts.count: Listen to two cards. Find the voices that count to the same number.
prompts.melody: Listen to two cards. Find the tunes that go together.
prompts.animals: Tap animal blocks to balance the seesaw. The numbers show their weights.
prompts.blocks: Tap number blocks to balance the seesaw. Tap a block again to take it off.
